description: Source code for QbonePacketProcessor class handling IPv6 packet processing, filtering, and ICMP responses within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor
classes.description: Handles IPv6 packet processing, filtering, and ICMP responses within the QUIC protocol.

methods.name: QbonePacketProcessor::QbonePacketProcessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packet processor with local and client IP addresses, subnet length, output, and stats interfaces.

methods.name: QbonePacketProcessor::ProcessIPv6HeaderAndFilter
methods.description: Processes IPv6 header and applies packet filter.

methods.name: QbonePacketProcessor::ProcessIPv6Header
methods.description: Validates and extracts IPv6 header information, checks address and TTL.

methods.name: QbonePacketProcessor::SendIcmpResponse
methods.description: Creates and sends an ICMP response packet.

methods.description: Creates and sends a TCP reset packet.
